theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_ret_uniform_injectivity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid d)) (L : Euclid d → (Euclid d →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), IsCompact K → ContinuousOn L K → (∀ v ∈ K, Injective (L v)) → ∃ b : ℝ, 0 ≤ b ∧ ∀ v ∈ K, ∀ w : Euclid d, ‖w‖ ≤ b * ‖L v w‖
